newsitem.title: USA: ATHLETICS-BOLDON RUNS YEAR'S FASTEST 100 METRES.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BOLDON RUNS YEAR'S FASTEST 100 METRES.

text.p: Ato Boldon of Trinidad ran the year's fastest 100 metres and seventh fastest of all time, winning a race in Modesto, California, in 9.89 seconds on Saturday.
The world record, set by Canada's Donovan Bailey at the Atlanta Olympics last year, is 9.84 seconds. Boldon was the bronze medallist in the 100 and 200 metres in Atlanta.
American John Drummond finished second in Saturday's race in 10:09.
